user_profiles_header_label_check.name: user_profiles_header_label_check
user_profiles_header_label_check.value: "user_profiles"."header_label" is null or (char_length("user_profiles"."header_label") between 1 and 64 and "user_profiles"."header_label" = btrim("user_profiles"."header_label"))

categories_name_i18n_nonblank_check.name: categories_name_i18n_nonblank_check
categories_name_i18n_nonblank_check.value:
("categories"."name_i18n"->>'en' is null or length(btrim("categories"."name_i18n"->>'en')) > 0)
				and ("categories"."name_i18n"->>'zh-cn' is null or length(btrim("categories"."name_i18n"->>'zh-cn')) > 0)
				and ("categories"."name_i18n"->>'ja' is null or length(btrim("categories"."name_i18n"->>'ja')) > 0)

links_https_check.name: links_https_check
links_https_check.value: "links"."url" like 'https://%' and ("links"."backlink_url" is null or "links"."backlink_url" like 'https://%')

links_ring_check.name: links_ring_check
links_ring_check.value: "links"."recent_checks" is null or (case when jsonb_typeof("links"."recent_checks") = 'array' then jsonb_array_length("links"."recent_checks") <= 10 else false end)

notes_coordinates_check.name: notes_coordinates_check
notes_coordinates_check.value: "notes"."coordinates" is null or (jsonb_typeof("notes"."coordinates") = 'object' and case when jsonb_typeof("notes"."coordinates" -> 'latitude') = 'number' and jsonb_typeof("notes"."coordinates" -> 'longitude') = 'number' then (("notes"."coordinates" ->> 'latitude')::numeric between -90 and 90 and ("notes"."coordinates" ->> 'longitude')::numeric between -180 and 180) else false end)

photos_coords_check.name: photos_coords_check
photos_coords_check.value: ("photos"."latitude" is null) = ("photos"."longitude" is null) and ("photos"."latitude" is null or ("photos"."latitude" between -90 and 90 and "photos"."longitude" between -180 and 180))

posts_provenance_source_by_check.name: posts_provenance_source_by_check
posts_provenance_source_by_check.value: "posts"."provenance_updated_by" is null or "posts"."provenance_source" is not null

topics_name_i18n_nonblank_check.name: topics_name_i18n_nonblank_check
topics_name_i18n_nonblank_check.value:
("topics"."name_i18n"->>'en' is null or length(btrim("topics"."name_i18n"->>'en')) > 0)
				and ("topics"."name_i18n"->>'zh-cn' is null or length(btrim("topics"."name_i18n"->>'zh-cn')) > 0)
				and ("topics"."name_i18n"->>'ja' is null or length(btrim("topics"."name_i18n"->>'ja')) > 0)

topics_description_i18n_nonblank_check.name: topics_description_i18n_nonblank_check
topics_description_i18n_nonblank_check.value:
("topics"."description_i18n"->>'en' is null or length(btrim("topics"."description_i18n"->>'en')) > 0)
				and ("topics"."description_i18n"->>'zh-cn' is null or length(btrim("topics"."description_i18n"->>'zh-cn')) > 0)
				and ("topics"."description_i18n"->>'ja' is null or length(btrim("topics"."description_i18n"->>'ja')) > 0)

webhook_secrets_previous_pair_check.name: webhook_secrets_previous_pair_check
webhook_secrets_previous_pair_check.value: ("webhook_secrets"."previous_ciphertext" is null) = ("webhook_secrets"."previous_expires_at" is null) and ("webhook_secrets"."previous_ciphertext" is null) = ("webhook_secrets"."previous_key_version" is null)
